name: Great Zimbabwe coursed stone enclosure
description: The Great Enclosure combined regularly coursed granite walls built without mortar with domestic living quarters.

date.label: Fourteenth century CE
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: UNESCO dates the Great Enclosure to the fourteenth century and describes cut granite blocks laid in regular courses.

evidence.supports: UNESCO dates the Great Enclosure to the fourteenth century and describes cut granite blocks laid in regular courses.
The museum describes the Great Enclosure and states that Great Zimbabwe’s walls were built from granite blocks without mortar.
